hints.tr: Karşılaştırmaları tersine çevir; ayrıca bilinmeyen eylem için ayrı bir `False` gerekiyor.
hints.en: Flip the comparisons; an unknown action also needs its own `False`.

hints.tr: `if action == "read": return s <= o`, `if action == "write": return s >= o`, sonra `return False`.
hints.en: `if action == "read": return s <= o`, `if action == "write": return s >= o`, then `return False`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
LEVELS = ["low", "medium", "high"]


def biba_allowed(subject, obj, action):
    s, o = LEVELS.index(subject), LEVELS.index(obj)
    if action == "read":
        return s <= o
    if action == "write":
        return s >= o
    return False

for subject, obj in [("medium", "low"), ("medium", "high"), ("high", "high")]:
    print(subject, obj, biba_allowed(subject, obj, "read"), biba_allowed(subject, obj, "write"))
print(biba_allowed("low", "low", "delete"))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

def biba_allowed(subject, obj, action):

    if action == "write":

    return False

for subject, obj in [("medium", "low"), ("medium", "high"), ("high", "high")]:
    print(subject, obj, biba_allowed(subject, obj, "read"), biba_allowed(subject, obj, "write"))
print(biba_allowed("low", "low", "delete"))
